disagreements.finding: V03 makes recovery re-entry neutral, but stops at CLOCK_EPOCH_REENTERED_SHADOW with routing_authority_allowed=false. The next stage could reload stale secretary pressure, anti-thrash hold age, terminal N/R state, previous clock/provider counters, or cached goal-continuity state and thereby undo the guarantees that V03 establishes at re-entry.

personality_contamination_risks: Authentic long-duration secretary pressure can still create chronic conservatism if downstream code retains history even though V03 resets the recovery projection.

A chain break/recovery can become trauma, helplessness, dependency or relief narrative if downstream event classification consumes recovery telemetry.
Terminal exit is the highest current reinjection risk: it can reload stale pressure/anti-thrash/goal-state caches after a neutral V03 re-entry.
Synthetic provider/key success can create false certainty if treated as production trust evidence.
